Info

Factory instantiating ReplLineReader instances.

class scaralang.infrastructure.cli.repl.input.repl_line_reader_factory.ReplLineReaderFactory[source]¶

Bases: object

Factory providing ReplLineReader instances.

It defines:

methods:
create - Builds ReplLineReader with strictly injected reader function.
create_default - Builds ReplLineReader with standard input reader.
get_version - Returns factory version string.
classmethod create(*, reader_func: Callable[[str], str]) → ReplLineReader[source]¶

Builds and returns a ReplLineReader with strictly injected reader function.

Parameters:

reader_func – Required custom callable taking prompt and returning string.

Returns:

Instantiated ReplLineReader instance.

Exceptions:

None.

classmethod create_default() → ReplLineReader[source]¶
